about_the_game:
Space Mechanics is a simulation game.

character management: w - forward, s - backward, a - left, d - right, q - turn left, e - turn right, space - up, c - down. If you hold your LB next to any object, it will follow the cursor.

repairing: The spaceships that need to be repaired will arrive to you. Using the default welding and spare parts from the in-game store, you will be able to fix them, and you will be paid for it. In total, there are 13 types of spaceships in the game, in order for the gate to open and the spaceship to fly in, you need to press the button near the gate. after the ship has flown in, you need to close the gate and inspect the spacecraft for problems and replace parts or use welding, depending on the situation. After you have fixed everything, you need to click on the same button, but if you have not fixed all the problems, then the button will not work.

hiring: You can hire spaceships for the money you earn, they will mine minerals, there are 12 spaceships that can be hired: 2 to find ore, 1 cheap miner, 1 ordinary miner, 1 upgraded miner, 3 ordinary defenders, 3 upgraded defenders and 1 superluminal spaceship. There can be a total of 6 squads in the game, 5 ships each, for each squad you need to hire 1 spaceship to find ore, miners and defenders, but you can use a superluminal spaceship as defenders, 1 superluminal spaceship = 2 upgraded defenders = 4 regular defenders. The more units are formed, the greater the chance to find the best ore. The ores will be spawned in a box called "ores".

crafting: You can create alloys, melting furnaces, and higher-level crafters in a regular crafter that you can buy. inside the crafter, instructions will be given on what resources are needed for crafting, after you put the necessary ingots in the right places, you need to close the hatch of the crafter and wait about 15 seconds, after that the item will appear in the crafter, if it is an improved crafter or an improved melting furnace, then it will appear in the room. There are 3 types of crafters, 1 uranium factory and 3 types of melting furnaces in the game. There are 5 types of ores in the game: iron, silver, gold, titanium and uranium. If any of these metals are melted down, its value will increase, and if an alloy is made from the melted ingots, the value will become even greater.

At the moment, the character's goal is to earn money.

short_description: In "Space Mechanics: Repair | Hiring | Craft" you are the owner of a space repair station in which you have to work. Repair spaceships, get money for it, hire them and create items for sale or for your own purposes.
